question: Which enclosed mantra form of the goddess of gods protects the sides of the body?
premises: The mantra is enclosed by ramā.
The goddess of gods is invoked through this mantra.
Protection is sought for the sides.
inference: The goddess of gods, invoked through the mantra enclosed by ramā, protects the sides.
uncertainties: ramayā may denote a specific bīja syllable
plain_english: May the goddess of gods, as the mantra enclosed by ramā, protect the sides.
